Description: Image statistics of each scene, as 1 x 120 arrays, one value per image in the order of stimulus_order.tsv (image_index). The analyses use Edge_r32 and RMS_r32. How the values were computed is not documented in this release.

image_name.Description: File name of each scene, in the order of stimulus_order.tsv. The ten conference-room scenes are spelled Conferenceroom here and Conferanceroom in stimulus_order.tsv.
